facts.title: UNCHE — United Nations Conference on the Human Environment
facts.text: The United Nations Conference on the Human Environment was held in Stockholm from 5 to 16 June 1972.

facts.title: Agenda 21 — UNCED adoption
facts.text: Agenda 21 was adopted by more than 178 Governments at the United Nations Conference on Environment and Development in Rio de Janeiro in 1992.

facts.title: Basel Convention — hazardous wastes
facts.text: The Basel Convention concerns control of transboundary movements of hazardous wastes and their disposal.

facts.title: Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety — 2000 adoption
facts.text: The Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety to the Convention on Biological Diversity was adopted on 29 January 2000.

facts.title: Kyoto Protocol — 1997 adoption
facts.text: The Kyoto Protocol was adopted on 11 December 1997.

facts.title: Earth Summit — Rio de Janeiro
facts.text: The United Nations Conference on Environment and Development, also known as the Earth Summit, was held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from 3 to 14 June 1992.
